title: Nightly evolution on main (gens 0–199)
author: Soundwave, Chief of Staff
body: The CoS morning cycle copies evolution JSON from nightly-data into main (ADR-007). Champion Charger 5/3/1 at 89.2% vs Gen 0 stays experimental and is not the viewer default. STATE catches up to GATE-003, B1 done, and the live company site.
next: Gen badge and slider; PettingZoo bridge; Nye call on the all-Charger plateau.
